A. Output: Video content (3 demonstration / instructional videos)
・"cold" Frankenwallet + CLI
・"cold" Frankenwallet + SPO Scripts
・"cool" Frankenwallet + user wallets

Acceptance criteria:
Reviewers can verify these videos are:
・Clearly separated according to the type of user (operators vs. end users) (general operators vs. those who use the SPO Scripts)
・Considerate of what each class of user will need to know before & after building the Frankenwallet: with guidelines for usage, containing both practical instructions and rationale for these procedures
・Generally following the structure of the web site documentation, with URLs of each relevant page at the top: so viewers can refer back to the site for help & details about any issue

Reviewers can confirm appropriate content for each video:
・(for operators) "cold" Frankenwallet detailed setup including Cardano CLI software, with basics of secure workflow
・(for operators + scripts) walk-through of scripts installation and workflow, demonstrated with key scripts for online-offline data collection & offline transaction signing
・(for asset holders) usage for browser wallets + dApps, with guidelines and warnings in support of security and privacy

Reviewers should note that the videos *do not* cover items abundantly covered elsewhere, including:
・(for general operators) How to use the Cardano CLI: already thoroughly documented on the Cardano Developer Portal and by many third parties
・(for SPO scripts) How to create and modify a stake pool with the SPO scripts: since the focus of this documentation is to verify correct installation and secure workflow for the scripts
・(for end users) How to install a browser wallet in the Frankenwallet: since this works exactly the same as it does everywhere else
